There's no dedicated flag for choosing a registry. You select it with the path argument and set credentials through environment variables.

**MLflow:** Pass a `models:/` URI as the path. For example, "promptfoo scan-model models:/MyModel/Latest" [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]. Set the tracking server and credentials first:

- "`MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI`: The URI of your MLflow tracking server." [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]
- "`MLFLOW_TRACKING_USERNAME` / `MLFLOW_TRACKING_PASSWORD`: Credentials for MLflow authentication." [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]

MLflow scanning also needs the `mlflow` package: "pip install mlflow" [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/index.md].

**JFrog Artifactory:** Pass the full artifact URL as the path, for example "promptfoo scan-model "https://your-domain.jfrog.io/artifactory/models/model.pkl"" [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]. Set the base URL and a token:

- "`JFROG_URL`: The base URL of your JFrog Artifactory instance." [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]
- "`JFROG_API_TOKEN` or `JFROG_ACCESS_TOKEN`: Your API or access token." [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]

Example setup from the same file:

```bash
export JFROG_URL="https://your-domain.jfrog.io"
export JFROG_API_TOKEN="your-api-token"
promptfoo scan-model "https://your-domain.jfrog.io/artifactory/repo/model.pkl"
```

The context doesn't say whether these environment variables can instead be set by a CLI option or config file.
